subject: Copywriting
title: The French Revolution Pamphlets
description: A 60-second lesson on The French Revolution Pamphlets.

hook.text: Before the French Revolution, 2,500 pamphlets circulated in Paris in 1789 alone. Words toppled a monarchy.

buildup.text: Writers like Abbé Sieyès asked: 'What is the Third Estate? Everything. What has it been?

discovery.text: Revolutionary pamphlets used short sentences, emotional language, and direct questions.

twist.text: After the revolution, the new government used the same pamphlet tactics to consolidate power.

climax.text: The French Revolution proved that copywriting can overthrow governments.

punchline.text: 2,500 pamphlets in one year. Words toppled the French monarchy.

quiz.question: How many pamphlets circulated in Paris in 1789?
